coverage: Eleven representative sacred sites in India and Nepal across Hindu, Muslim, Buddhist, Jain and Christian communities. Sikh sites are maintained separately in the existing gurdwara catalogue. This is a curated sample, not an exhaustive list or a measure of community population.

sources.title: Wikidata: shrine identities and coordinate claims
sources.note: Site records link their specific Wikidata entity. Structured data licensed CC0. Coordinates are community-maintained; they are not survey measurements.

sources.title: Wikimedia Commons: real shrine photographs
sources.note: Each photo records its file page, photographer, exact reuse license, original URL, and display changes. Photographs are downloaded locally. Individual licenses govern the images.
